sg-6-0-2-11.title: Shafts of Amber Light
sg-6-0-2-11.text:
Shafts of filtered amber light pierce down through narrow ventilation shafts, illuminating floating motes of quartz dust in the stillness of the subterranean hall. Your banked coal-lantern casts a competing red glow against the ancient masonry, warming the damp air.

You slip behind a stack of slate partition slabs, hiding from the distant, rhythmic clank of automated machinery echoing through the masonry.

sg-6-0-3-0.title: Copper Treads Ring Softly
sg-6-0-3-0.text: You climb a spiral stair of hollow copper treads that ring like chimes beneath your boots, threatening to wake the silent halls with every careful step. A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. Alternatively, you can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt.

sg-6-0-3-1.title: Alkaline Drift of Salt
sg-6-0-3-1.text: A stone basin filled with salt crystals blocks the threshold, forcing you to wade through a crunching drift of alkaline powder that stings your ankles. A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. Alternatively, you can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt.

sg-6-0-3-2.title: Arched Gallery of Lead
sg-6-0-3-2.text: An arched gallery of ribbed lead tubes hums softly with the vibration of distant winds sweeping across the surface above. A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. You can also scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt, or step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim.

sg-6-0-3-3.title: Gypsum Needles in the Fissure
sg-6-0-3-3.text: You squeeze through a fissure in the limestone where glittering gypsum needles brush against your woolen travelling cloak. A grand double door of iron-studded oak stands slightly ajar ahead, leaking a smell of dry chaff and ancient preservation. Alternatively, you can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt.

sg-6-0-3-4.title: Rusted Shears and Glass Beads
sg-6-0-3-4.text: A wooden workbench holds a rusted set of jeweler's shears and a bowl of clouded glass beads left mid-polish by an unknown hand. A rusted winch mechanism spans the corridor nearby, its iron chain sagging into a heap of orange flakes upon the flagstones. You might also follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, or descend a stone staircase into a thick bank of subterranean mist.

sg-6-0-3-5.title: Petrified Timber Bridge
sg-6-0-3-5.text: You cross a bridge of petrified timber over a dry irrigation canal, its wooden ribs groaning under your cautious weight in the hollow quiet. You can scramble down a chute of polished green glass, sliding past rows of empty bin markers cut into the basalt, or step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim.

sg-6-0-3-6.title: Peeling Fresco of Green Barley
sg-6-0-3-6.text: A fresco of green barley stalks peels from the plaster in long ribbons, revealing dark volcanic rock beneath the grand design. You can step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim, follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, or retrace your steps past a pillar of fused glass where an abandoned cart of rotting wicker baskets holds only dust and grey husks.

sg-6-0-3-7.title: Iron Ringbolt and Drainage Pit
sg-6-0-3-7.text: An iron ringbolt is set into the floor beside a gaping drainage pit, its shank polished bright by heavy ropes that once hauled loads through the dark. You can follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage, or descend a stone staircase into a thick bank of subterranean mist that clings to the floor like chilled breath.

sg-6-0-3-8.title: Unmonitored Maintenance Hatch
sg-6-0-3-8.text: Owing no debts to the toll-lords allows you to bypass the locked toll-gate entirely, slipping through an unmonitored maintenance hatch into the inner vaults without a murmur of protest. You can step through a shattered fanlight into a long gallery where rows of bronze seed-urns stretch into the dim, or follow a narrow service catwalk that hugs the apex of the ceiling, offering a bird's-eye view of the vast, silent storage below.
